summary.text: Bidal Duran is a Republican state representative from Minnesota House District 2A who has served since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Marine Corps veteran, he has a career in law enforcement.

paragraphs.text: Bidal Duran served in the U.S. Marine Corps.
He earned an associate degree and a bachelor's degree from Bemidji State University and a graduate degree in criminal justice from Concordia University.
His career experience includes working in law enforcement.
Duran assumed office on January 14, 2025, succeeding Matthew Grossell, and his current term ends on January 12, 2027.
The Republican primary for the seat on August 11, 2026, was canceled.
